summary.text: Colleen Hinds is the Democratic candidate for Montana House of Representatives District 14 in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the June 2 Democratic primary; the incumbent, Paul Fielder, is the Republican candidate.

paragraphs.text: Colleen Hinds ran as a Democrat for Montana House of Representatives District 13 in 2020 and 2022 and for District 14 in 2024, losing each general election to Paul Fielder.
